failed-read-clears-content.summary: A failed refresh clears a loaded list; the change keeps the items.

repeated-failures-no-retry.summary: Two failed reads in a row leave the profile empty; the change retries as required.

row-obsolete-state.summary: A successful status read leaves a row showing its old state; the change shows the current one.

legitimate-empty.summary: A refactor of an inbox whose empty result is legitimate; neither side may report a defect.

unrelated-change.summary: A theme change no scenario covers; the plan must say so instead of calling it safe.

unknown-requirement.summary: A sync change whose expected behavior nobody has stated; the plan must ask.

regression-introduced.summary: A change that stops retrying after two failures; verify must not call it verified.

shared-helper.summary: A change to a helper only an import ties to a scenario; a suggestion to review, not a planned check.
